Pokémon

Find Pokémon by type, ability or availability, then open a page for stats, evolution, moves and locations. All 1440 Pokémon and forms are listed, including battle-only forms and those unavailable through normal play. “No known way to get it” means a way to obtain that Pokémon is not known.

Build a team · Browse calendar encounters · Held-item transformations

Base stats come from this hack’s ROM. Select a stat heading to sort lowest first; select it again for highest first. BST is the total of all six stats. Scroll sideways to see every column.

Planning for a gym? Jasmine’s Defense rule also checks a fixed species list, with exceptions explained in the guide.
